title: Disable Gamebar
name: disable-gamebar
warning: Do NOT use on AMD Ryzen X3D CPUs (5800X3D/7800X3D/9800X3D) — Windows needs Game Bar to schedule games on 3D V-Cache cores.
docs_warning: Do not enable this if you have an X3D CPU (e.g., AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D / 9800X3D) as Windows uses Game Bar to allocate 3D V-Cache cores to games.
modal:
**When to use:** On Intel or non-X3D AMD CPUs if you want to remove Xbox Game Bar overlays and background capture.

**When NOT to use:** Do NOT enable if you have an **AMD Ryzen X3D CPU** (e.g., 7800X3D, 7950X3D, 9800X3D), as disabling Game Bar breaks 3D V-Cache core scheduling.
deepDescription: Attempts to remove Xbox Gaming Overlay using Remove-AppxPackage, with a fallback to winget, to eliminate background Xbox services and overlays that can consume CPU, RAM, and GPU resources, improving system performance and reducing in-game interruptions.
